description: Telangana district-level crop-yield forecasting with transparent historical baselines (B0-B4). Fixed-origin evaluation is primary; rolling-origin evaluation is secondary.
random_seed_note: No step uses randomness; all calculations are deterministic.

dataset.label_normalization: Leading/trailing whitespace is stripped from State_Name, District_Name, Season and Crop in memory only. Labels are then matched by exact string equality: no case folding, no fuzzy matching, no merging of distinct crop names.
dataset.path_note: Relative paths are resolved against the project root (the parent of configs/). Override with --data PATH; the file is always identified by its SHA-256.

scope.excluded_crops_reason: Season labels change between the training and test periods; both crops are outside the 12 core crop-seasons in any case.

row_exclusions.min_area_note: The 10 ha cutoff is a methodological choice to drop tiny, noisy plots; it is not a proven universal rule.

target.name: yield
target.unit: Recorded production units per hectare (crop-specific; see unit and unit_note).

coverage_rules.train_years_rule_applies_to: every expected panel district, within each forecast's training information set

rolling_origin.label: SECONDARY - each target year uses only observations strictly earlier than that year
rolling_origin.origin_note: forecast_origin_year = target_year - 1 (agreed design). For 2013 the origin is 2012, a year with no records; the run asserts that no eligible observation exists between training_cutoff_year and forecast_origin_year, so the information set is identical to 'all years <= 2011'.

baselines.info_set: Eligible rows of the same crop-season with Crop_Year <= training_cutoff_year. Target-year rows are never part of the info set.

B0.name: Crop-season mean
B0.rule: Unweighted mean yield of all info-set rows (all panel districts and years).

B1.name: District historical mean
B1.rule: Mean yield of the district's info-set rows.

B2.name: Recent five-year district mean
B2.rule: Mean yield of the district's info-set rows with forecast_origin_year-4 <= Crop_Year <= forecast_origin_year (five calendar-year labels).

B3.name: Last observed district yield
B3.rule: Yield of the district's most recent info-set row with forecast_origin_year-2 <= Crop_Year <= forecast_origin_year.

B4.name: District mean plus Telangana-wide within-district trend
B4.rule: B1 district mean + beta * (target_year - district mean info-set year).
B4.beta: Pooled within-district OLS slope of yield on Crop_Year over all info-set rows of the crop-season: beta = sum_d sum_i (t_i - tbar_d)(y_i - ybar_d) / sum_d sum_i (t_i - tbar_d)^2. Centering by district removes persistent district level differences.
B4.fallback: If the district has fewer than B1.min_years info-set rows and beta is defined: B0 + beta * (target_year - mean info-set year of the crop-season). If beta is undefined: B0 alone.

outlier_flags.method: robust_z = (yield - median) / (1.4826 * MAD), median and MAD from the crop-season's fixed-origin training rows only

metrics.WAPE: sum(|e|) / sum(|observed|); undefined (left blank, with note) if sum(|observed|) == 0
metrics.skill_vs_B1: 1 - MSE_baseline / MSE_B1 on the identical rows; undefined (left blank, with note) if MSE_B1 == 0; B1's own skill is 0 by definition
metrics.aggregation_rule: Native-unit metrics (MAE, RMSE, bias) are reported per crop-season only. Cross-crop summaries use unit-free WAPE and skill (median, counts) only. No pooled MAE, RMSE or R^2 is computed.

output.output_dir_rule: Passed with --out; must not already exist and must not be inside the dataset's directory.
